mapper.select: SELECT mbd.mbd_id, mbd.mb_id, mbd.dr_id, mbd.mbd_drug_name, mbd.mbd_drug_effect, mbd.mbd_writer_id, mbd.mbd_reg_date, dr.dr_sungsang FROM MEMBER_DRUG_TB mbd JOIN DRUG_TB dr ON mbd.dr_id = dr.dr_id WHERE mbd.mb_id = #{mb_id}

SELECT DR_ID, MBD_DRUG_NAME, DR_SUNGSANG, CNT_MEMBER FROM ( SELECT dt.DR_ID, mdt.MBD_DRUG_NAME, dt.DR_SUNGSANG, COUNT(DISTINCT mdt.MB_ID) AS CNT_MEMBER FROM MEMBER_DRUG_TB mdt JOIN DRUG_TB dt ON dt.DR_ID = mdt.DR_ID GROUP BY dt.DR_ID, mdt.MBD_DRUG_NAME, dt.DR_SUNGSANG ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT mdt.MB_ID) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
